#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Unpack a .docx and pretty-print its XML files (stdlib-only)."""
import random
import sys
import zipfile
import xml.dom.minidom
from pathlib import Path

input_file, output_dir = sys.argv[1], sys.argv[2]

output_path = Path(output_dir)
output_path.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
zipfile.ZipFile(input_file).extractall(output_path)

for xml_file in list(output_path.rglob("*.xml")) + list(output_path.rglob("*.rels")):
    content = xml_file.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
    dom = xml.dom.minidom.parseString(content)
    xml_file.write_bytes(dom.toprettyxml(indent="  ", encoding="ascii"))

if input_file.endswith(".docx"):
    suggested_rsid = "".join(random.choices("0123456789ABCDEF", k=8))
    print(f"Suggested RSID for edit session: {suggested_rsid}")

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Print raw XML of paragraphs whose text matches heading patterns."""
import sys
import xml.dom.minidom

dom = xml.dom.minidom.parse("unpacked/word/document.xml")

HEADINGS = [
    "EXECUTIVE SUMMARY",
    "FINANCIAL HIGHLIGHTS",
    "REVENUE BREAKDOWN BY SEGMENT",
    "KEY PERFORMANCE INDICATORS",
    "OPERATING EXPENSES",
    "Q1 2025 OUTLOOK",
    "RISK FACTORS",
]

for i, p in enumerate(dom.getElementsByTagName("w:p")):
    texts = []
    for r in p.getElementsByTagName("w:r"):
        for t in r.childNodes:
            if t.nodeType == t.ELEMENT_NODE and t.tagName.split(":")[-1] in ("t", "delText"):
                texts.append(t.firstChild.nodeValue if t.firstChild else "")
    text = "".join(texts)
    if text in HEADINGS:
        print(f"=== Paragraph {i}: {text!r} ===")
        print(p.toxml())
        print()
